steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Describe: state what the data shows using numbers and features (e.g. ‘The median is 45 and the IQR is 12’); do not explain why | Key Fact: Explain: give reasons for what the data shows (e.g. ‘The median is higher because older participants had more experience’); link to context | Key Fact: Compare: state similarities and differences between groups, using comparative language and specific data values from each group | Key Fact: Evaluate: weigh up strengths and weaknesses, or assess the usefulness/validity of a method or result; reach a balanced judgement
